projects.name: My shelf painting
projects.shortDescription: A still-life shelf painting developed over several weeks as my professor taught the painting process, featuring a Mountain Dew can, playing card, and folding knife.

projects.name: wood creek Painting
projects.shortDescription: An oil painting made outdoors beside a favorite creek during winter, completed over roughly a week for a homework assignment.

projects.name: Reality Inception Painting
projects.shortDescription: A surreal painting inspired by René Magritte’s The Son of Man and The Key to the Fields, featuring red curtains, a shattered window, and a canvas viewed from the artist’s perspective.

projects.name: Chalk Eskimo
projects.shortDescription: A guided black chalk drawing depicting a face framed by the hood of winter clothing.

projects.name: Chalk Lion
projects.shortDescription: A guided black chalk drawing of a lion’s head, created during a Heritage homeschool art lesson.

projects.name: Peacock Chalk Drawing
projects.shortDescription: A guided chalk drawing of a full peacock with sparse, web-like plumage rather than a broad, fully spread tail.

projects.name: Clipped Baby Jesus
projects.shortDescription: A Christmas-themed drawing of baby Jesus in Mary’s arms, with magazine clippings used to create their clothing.

projects.name: Flowered Heart
projects.shortDescription: A heart-shaped composition formed from several flowers in different shades of blue.
